answer_result.answer: Dave finds restoring old cars satisfying because it feels like bringing something back to life. He describes it as therapeutic/relaxing, and says seeing a car go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty is cool and worth the elbow grease. He is especially satisfied by the end result and by people's reactions to the finished product, which makes all the hard work worth it. It also gives him fulfillment and a sense of purpose, and he enjoys the challenge and personalizing the small details—like customizing a work of art on wheels. A related fond memory is restoring an old car with his dad and feeling satisfied knowing they did it together.
